description: This Swift source file defines the MenuSessionsInjector class, which manages injecting dynamic session, node, usage, and cost information into an NSMenu in a macOS application, handling cache updates, asynchronous data loading, and user interactions.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: A macOS-specific class responsible for injecting dynamic session and node information into NSMenu, managing state, caching, and asynchronous data loads, with support for testing overrides.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initializes the injector into a specified NSStatusItem, setting itself as the menu delegate and starting cache refresh tasks.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Triggers cache refresh and injects session, usage, and node info into the menu before it opens.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Resets internal state and cancels ongoing tasks when the menu closes.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Allows the delegate to update the menu, typically to refresh dynamic content.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides the rectangle within which the menu is confined on screen.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Main method to populate the menu with session data, including headers, session items, usage, and cost sections.

methods.name: injectNodes
methods.description: Adds node entries and overflow menu to the menu.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and caches session snapshots with optional force update.

methods.name: refreshUsageCache
methods.description: Loads and caches usage summary data, respecting refresh intervals.

methods.name: refreshCostUsageCache
methods.description: Loads and caches cost usage summaries, managing errors.

methods.name: buildSubmenu
methods.description: Creates a submenu with session previews, details, and management actions for a session row.

methods.name: buildNodesOverflowMenu
methods.description: Builds a submenu listing additional node entries beyond the initial set.

methods.name: buildNodeSubmenu
methods.description: Provides detailed node info and copy options for a node entry.

methods.name: makeHostedView
methods.description: Wraps a SwiftUI view into an NSView with sizing considerations for menu display.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable
methods.description: Records the menu's width after layout to optimize future display sizes.

methods.name: initialWidth
methods.description: Determines the initial width of the menu based on current state.

methods.name: submenuWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width for submenus, respecting open menu state.
